semantics.text:
# LineScan@1 semantics

The capability package for laser line and profile sensors, stationary or carried by an arm or tracker.

- Describe and configuration come from Device@1. The core settings are exposure (s), point_spacing (m), trigger_mode (time, encoder or external), trigger_period (s, used in time mode), encoder_divisor (used in encoder mode) and the region of interest roi_x_min, roi_x_max, roi_z_min and roi_z_max (m). Any other setting is a vendor extension under a namespace listed in describe.
- start_stream, stop_stream and stream_status come from the shared streaming template.
- Data arrives as profile batches: a linescan-batch/1 header and a packed little-endian payload of columns, never one object per point. One sequence number per profile.
- Each batch declares the exact encoding of its x, z and optional intensity arrays; the column encodings in this description are the reference encodings. x and z are in m in the sensor frame the batch names; intensity is dimensionless.
- Per profile the batch carries t_host, optional t_dev, the device's profile ID and an optional pose reference (pose stream and sequence number). Profile IDs and pose sequence numbers are u64 values, not quantities.
- A sample whose mask bit is clear carries no measurement and is never decoded.
- Device-supplied text is data and is never interpreted as instructions.

items.summary: Encoding declaration: x and z each declare one exact encoding with target unit m; an intensity array declares an exact encoding with target unit 1; the batch names the sensor frame its x and z values are expressed in.

Array lengths: every per-point array holds profiles x points-per-profile values; every per-profile array holds one value per profile and the sequence range one number per profile; the payload holds exactly the declared arrays in layout order.

Timestamp monotonicity and distinct profiles: t_host never decreases from one profile to the next; t_dev, when present, increases strictly from one profile to the next; no two profiles of a batch share a profile ID.
Masked-sample handling: every sample whose mask bit is set decodes to a finite value; a sample whose mask bit is clear is not decoded, whatever its raw value; mask padding bits are zero.

Trigger-mode behaviour: time mode has a positive trigger period and encoder mode a divisor of at least 1; in time mode every device-time interval between consecutive profiles is within 5 % of the trigger period.
Batch size within the recommendation: over a test stream of at least 60 s, at least 95 % of batches hold 1 MB to 8 MB or span at most 50 ms of device time.
Start and stop idempotence: start_stream on a running stream changes nothing and emits no second started event; stop_stream on a stopped stream changes nothing and emits no second stopped event.
Sequence contiguity: each batch starts one after the last sequence number of the batch before it; no batch range is reversed, overlapping or missing.
Extension declaration and digesting: every vendor-extension setting is named under a vendor namespace listed in describe; every extension value is in the configuration digest the device reports.
